resources.string: LumenRead runs its models on your own computer. Start the server there, then enter its address here. Nothing is sent to anyone else.
Access token (only if you set PR_TOKEN)
Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://
Cannot reach the server. Check that it is running and that the phone is on the same network.
The microphone only works on https:// or http://localhost. See the README for how to set that up.
